fullPassage: It is common sense that people's inner beliefs may drive their external behavior. If you're attracted to a certain person, you should be more likely to socialize with that person. If you favor a brand of toothpaste, you're more likely to buy it. Of course, our internal thoughts don't always predict our public behavior, but, overall, what we do obviously reflects what we think. But beliefs and behaviors are also related in a more remarkable way. It turns out that the arrow is as likely to point in the reverse direction. As social psychologist David Myers observes, "If social psychology has taught us anything during the last 25 years, it is that we are likely not only to think ourselves into a way of acting but also to act ourselves into a way of thinking."

Of course, our internal thoughts don't always predict our public behavior, but, overall, __________ we do obviously reflects what we think. But beliefs and behaviors are also related in a more remarkable way. It turns out that the arrow is as likely to point in the reverse direction. As social psychologist David Myers observes, "If social psychology has taught us anything during the last 25 years, it is that we are likely not only to think ourselves into a way of acting but also to act ourselves into a way of thinking."
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오. (영어로)
"전반적으로, 우리가 하는 것은 분명히 우리가 생각하는 것을 반영한다."
→ ..., overall, __________ we do obviously reflects __________ we think.
[조건] (1) 동일한 관계대명사를 두 빈칸에 사용할 것 (2) 각 1단어

det.korean: __________ 우리가 하는 것은 분명히 우리가 생각하는 것을 반영한다.
det.analysis: ✅ what: what we do / what we think. 관계대명사 what = the thing(s) that
det.tip: what we do = 우리가 하는 것. what = 선행사 포함 관계대명사

If you favor a brand of toothpaste, you're more likely to buy it. Of course, our internal thoughts don't always predict our public behavior, but, overall, what we do obviously reflects what we think. But beliefs and behaviors are also related in a more remarkable way. It turns out that the arrow is as likely to point in the reverse direction. As social psychologist David Myers observes, "If social psychology has taught us anything during the last 25 years, it is that we are likely not only to think ourselves into a way of acting but also to act ourselves into a way of thinking."

"당신이 특정 사람에게 끌린다면, 그 사람과 교류할 가능성이 더 높다."

[조건] (1) attract를 알맞은 형태로 바꿀 것 (2) 1단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 특정 사람에게 __________되면 어울릴 가능성이 더 높다.
det.analysis: ✅ attracted: be attracted to = ~에 끌리다 (수동태). attract → attracted
det.tip: attract(끌다) → attracted(끌리는). be attracted to = ~에 끌리다
